# PR #5218: Patch: card sound hooks for triggered effects (turn, Whenever, Activate, hurt, hit), line pools, effect sequences and a 32 MiB voice budget

Closes #5188

Part 1 of #5187. Cards can now carry sounds for six new hooks (`startOfTurn`, `endOfTurn`, `whenever`, `activate`, `hurt`, `hit`), any spoken hook can have a pool of lines, an effect can be a list played in order, and the voice budget goes to 32 MiB. No voice line is written or rendered: `voice-text.json`, `voice-manifest.json` and `public/audio/voice/` are unchanged. One thing needs a person: the census floors and ceilings and the gzip cap are the plan's reading of #5187, which neither the planner nor I could read. They check nothing until part 2 lists a range, but someone should compare them with #5187's table before then.

## What changed

**The six hooks** (R5188000). They are new rows in `CARD_HOOKS`, also listed in `RECURRING_HOOKS`.
- `startOfTurn`, `endOfTurn`, `whenever` and `activate` play when the engine's `hookResolving` marker (R2783000) names the card. Its `cry` and `death` add no hook, since `play`, `cast` and `death` already sound at R204's moments.
- `hurt` plays on a `damage` to a Unit that is still on the field in the view its action ends in.
- `hit` plays on a `damage` whose `sourceId` is a card this seat can read. The card is found in either of the seat's views, else by what this turn's own `cardPlayed`, `summoned`, `trapFired` or marker events called it.
- Nothing plays for a card behind the sentinel (R203).

**When a recurring hook speaks** (director.ts `lineGate`).
- Its effect plays every time, once per animation entry, and a condensed burst keeps one.
- Its line speaks the first time that card's hook fires in a game. After that it speaks at most once a turn per card, with chance `TRIGGER_LINE_CHANCE` (1/3) from the client's cosmetic rng.
- The line is at `VOICE_PRIORITY.recurring` (0, R204's lowest), so it never cuts in.

**Pools.** Any spoken hook may give a list of lines. The first keeps today's key (`<id>-play`) and the rest are `<id>-play2`, `<id>-play3`, and so on. A hook with one line draws nothing from the rng.
- `lineFor`, the new `hookLines` and `pickLine`, `withVoiceText`, `gen-voice.mjs` and the pick-up all handle pools.
- `export_card_text.rs` accepts a pool on any hook (a `Line` enum) and the six new hooks by their camelCase names.

**Effect lists.** A hook's `effect` may be a list. Each effect starts `EFFECT_SEQUENCE_GAP_MS` (60 ms) after the one before it ends. The retrigger window and the voice cap check the list once, by its first effect.

**Space** (R5188001).
- `VOICE_BUDGET_BYTES` and `BUDGET_BYTES` are 32 MiB, from the manifest: today's 1,908 files take 20.49 MiB in 4 KiB blocks, and 1,331 lines at the attack lines' mean of 8.43 KiB add 10.96 MiB, 31.45 MiB in all.
- The ruling notes that Infinite Assault's 523 lines will need a raise of their own.
- `VOICE_NEW_LINE_MAX_WORDS` (4) applies to every line not in `census-baseline.json`, which holds `main`'s sounds as written before any edit.
- `SOUND_TABLES_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` is 18 × 8192 (147,456). The three tables measure 90,954 bytes today, and my re-run of the growth simulation gave 142,018.
- The census lives in `test/census.ts` and `sound-space.test.ts`, with `CENSUS_RANGES` empty.

**Records and proof.**
- Rulings R5188000 and R5188001, their paragraphs in `spec/pending/5188.md`, and §10.11's Voice lines and Card hooks paragraphs.
- The headers of `card-audio.json5` and `card-text.yaml`, rows 6 and 7 of `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, and the web README's voice section.
- Effect-only proof hooks on four cards outside the dev decks: #37's start of turn, #93's end of turn, #91's Whenever and #33's Activate.

## How I tested it

All of these exit 0:
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`: 816 files, 14,909 passed, 177 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/audio src/cards/inspect src/i18n`: 46 files, 1,223 passed, 5 skipped (macOS-only tests).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`: clean.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`: 5 passed. `voice-text.json`, `flavour.json` and `chinese.json` come out unchanged.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: "2726 rulings, 6636 proofs … ok".
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: "Internal".
- `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo jackioh patches check`: ok.
- `node apps/web/scripts/gen-voice.mjs --check`: "ok, 1908 files, 17595170 bytes".

The new tests are the ones the plan lists, plus a few:
- a pool preloads every line;
- a list of effects logs each one as suspended when the audio context isn't running;
- a marker kind this build doesn't know plays nothing;
- `soundUnits` counts a pool's lines one by one and a list of effects as one sound.

## Decisions the issue left open

| Decided | Rejected |
|---|---|
| The once-a-turn limit is per card, across all six hooks | Per hook |
| A first-time line uses up that card's turn | Not counting it |
| The first-time record lasts as long as the director, across a hand-over | Resetting it at a hand-over |
| A line the flush drops still counts as spoken | Not counting it |
| New trigger lines take the four-word cap; shipped ones keep 8 | No cap on new trigger lines |
| `hit` follows the issue's table: any `damage` naming the card as `sourceId`, a defender's return damage included | Only damage the card itself dealt |
| Deduping effects per entry applies only to the six new hooks | All hooks, which would change how shipped hooks sound |
| `named` and the once-a-turn record are also cleared at a hand-over | Clearing them only at turn start |

## Where I departed from the plan

- **Preloading.** `voiceKeysForView` preloads every line of a pool, so a picked line isn't fetched late.
- **Pick-up.** `playPickup` falls back to `"attack"` when `pickLine` finds no line. This keeps today's behaviour for a card with a manifest file but no voice in the table.
- **Unknown marker kinds.** The `hookResolving` row widens its lookup, so a marker kind this build doesn't know plays nothing (#769), the way `soundRow` handles unknown event types.
- **Tests aimed at shipped rules.** Two B33 counts in `voice-lines.test.ts` now count only play, attack, death and cast. Otherwise a card part's new voiced hook would break the "exactly the lines §10.11 requires" check. The effect-only test in `voice-assets.test.ts` is narrowed to the same four hooks.
- **Gzip figure.** The constant's doc gives my re-run (about 142,000 bytes), not the plan's 139,400.

## Worth a second look

- **Timing of the marker.** A `hookResolving` entry is 0 ms, so the runner skips it (it only "passes" it). Its sounds come from the director's flush before the next entry, or at idle. That flush keeps only the burst's most important effect and line, so a Spell's cast effect beats its `hit` effect when both land in one flush.
- **Hidden information (R203).** `readableDefOf` in cues.ts and `remember` in director.ts are the new paths that turn an instance into a card. `named` never stores the sentinel, drops an entry when a later event calls the card the sentinel, and is cleared each turn and at a hand-over.

# #5188: Patch: card sound hooks for triggered effects (turn, Whenever, Activate, hurt, hit), line pools, effect sequences and a 32 MiB voice budget
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part 1 of #5187. Its Today and space-rules sections hold the measurements this part relies on. Nothing blocks it; part 3 can build beside it.

## What it does

Adds to `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5` the hooks and shapes the card parts will fill, the rules for when those hooks play, and room on disk for their lines. **It writes no new voice line**, so it needs no render.

## The new hooks (client only: R655, R203; CLAUDE.md rule 7)

| Hook | Plays when | From the event stream |
|---|---|---|
| `startOfTurn` | a start-of-turn hook of the card begins to resolve, on either player's turn | `hookResolving` with `hook: "startOfTurn"` and the card as `sourceId` (R2783000) |
| `endOfTurn` | an end-of-turn hook of it begins to resolve | `hookResolving`, `"endOfTurn"` |
| `whenever` | one of its Whenever triggers runs, its condition held | `hookResolving`, `"whenever"` |
| `activate` | one of its Activate abilities runs | `hookResolving`, `"activate"` |
| `hurt` | a Unit takes damage and is still on the field when that action ends | `damage` on it, amount above 0, with no `destroyed` of it in that action |
| `hit` | damage the card is the source of lands: its Spell's, its effect's or its attack's | `damage` with the card as `sourceId` |

Each takes what today's hooks take: `{ voice }`, `{ effect }`, or both, with the effect first. A line's words go in the card's `voice` in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`, under the hook's name. `hookResolving`'s `cry` and `death` add no hook, because `play`, `cast` and `death` already sound at R204's moments. Part 2 adds the hooks R2783000 leaves unmarked.

## Two new shapes

- **Line pools.** Any voiced hook may give a list of lines, as `trigger` does (R1088). That includes today's `play`, `attack`, `death` and `cast`. One line is picked by the client's cosmetic rng, never the match's. The first line keeps today's key and file (`<id>-play`), and the others are `<id>-play2`, `<id>-play3`, and so on. A new hook's keys are `<id>-startOfTurn`, `<id>-startOfTurn2`, and so on. `apps/web/scripts/gen-voice.mjs` renders and checks them, and no shipped file's key changes.
- **Effect sequences.** `effect` may be a list of bank effects, played in order with a named gap between them: a wind-up, the release, a tail. The card parts build Spell sounds from these.

## When a recurring hook speaks

`startOfTurn`, `endOfTurn`, `whenever`, `activate`, `hurt` and `hit` can fire every turn, or many times in one action, so:

- its effect plays each time, once per entry, and a condensed burst keeps one, as R655 has it;
- its line speaks the first time the hook fires in a game. After that it speaks at most once per turn per card, with a chance (`TRIGGER_LINE_CHANCE`, about 1 in 3) drawn from the cosmetic rng;
- the line has R204's lowest priority: it never cuts in on another line, waits briefly, and is dropped if it waits too long.

The constants go in `apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts` (CLAUDE.md rule 9). Both seats hear the hook of a card the viewer can read; `attack` is different, since only the viewer's own pick-up plays it. A card behind the sentinel plays nothing (R203), and `hookResolving` never reaches a seat that could not read the card (R2783000).

## Space (#5187, the space rules)

- `VOICE_BUDGET_BYTES` (`apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts`) and `BUDGET_BYTES` (`gen-voice.mjs`) go from 24 to **32 MiB**, still counted in 4 KiB blocks. The change comes under a ruling from this issue's block that states the arithmetic (#5187, space rule 4), as R1884000 and R3596000 did.
- New lines are four words at most, checked where the attack lines are checked (`voice-lines.test.ts`).
- **A gzip cap on the sound tables** (`card-audio.json5`, `voice-text.json`, `voice-manifest.json`), as a named constant. Set it from today's 89 KB plus the card parts' growth (about 3,000 hook entries and at most 1,331 lines), with room for that and no more. Test it the way `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts` tests the first load (#3499).
- **The census.** A test that counts, for every card in the ranges it lists, the sounds added since this part. The lines and effects on `main` before this part are its baseline, and the test may snapshot them. It fails on any card below its rarity's floor or above its voice ceiling (#5187's table, as named constants). It lists no range yet: each card part adds its own, a range of catalog ids per line.

## Also

- **Spec:** §10.11's Card hooks and Voice lines paragraphs, and a ruling note from this issue's block with its proving tests. The ruling amends R655 (the hooks), R1088 (pools on every hook) and R204 (the new lines' priority). Its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<N>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- **Docs:** the headers of `card-audio.json5` and `card-text.yaml`, and rows 6 and 7 of `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, say what a card may now carry.
- **Proof:** test fixtures, plus effect-only hooks (which render nothing) on at most four real cards, one per `hookResolving` kind.

## Acceptance

- [ ] each of the six hooks plays its card's effect and line at its moment, and nothing for a card behind the sentinel (`director.test.ts`, `cues.test.ts`)
- [ ] pools work on every voiced hook, keyed as above; `gen-voice.mjs --check` and `gen-voice.test.ts` know them, and no shipped key changes (`--check` on `main`'s files still passes)
- [ ] effect sequences play in order, their gap a named constant
- [ ] the recurring-hook rule holds, with its constants
- [ ] the budget is 32 MiB in both places, under its ruling
- [ ] the four-word cap, the tables' gzip cap and the census (with no ranges yet) are in place
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` are green
